title: Ashbury Rewards Training Note: Counting the Transfer Allowance Already Used
content:
The part of an Ashbury Rewards member's transfer allowance already used is counted over the twelve months before the handling date.

**On what does the allowance used depend?**
On the tier and on the months since enrolment. For a member at Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite it is the points transferred out in the twelve months before the handling date less the points received by transfer in the same twelve months, never below zero; for a member at Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite or Platinum Elite enrolled for at least one hundred and twenty months it is the points transferred out in those twelve months less an exemption of twenty-five thousand points, never below zero. For other members the allowance used carries no netting and no exemption under this note.

**Which twelve months?**
The transactions posted after the same day number twelve months earlier, up to and including the handling date. The months since enrolment are whole calendar months from the enrolment date to the handling date.

**What does that look like? (hypothetical members)**

| Tier | Months enrolled | Points transferred out in the twelve months | Points received by transfer in the twelve months | Allowance used |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Titanium Elite | 40 | 90000 | 35000 | 55000 |
| Ambassador Elite | 200 | 20000 | 45000 | 0 (never below zero) |
| Platinum Elite | 120 | 60000 | 10000 | 35000 (60000 less the 25000 exemption) |
| Gold Elite | 130 | 18000 | 0 | 0 (never below zero) |

**Does the exemption apply to a Gold Elite member enrolled for 119 months?**
No. The exemption of 25000 points applies at Gold Elite or Platinum Elite only from 120 whole months of enrolment.

**Do points received count against the used allowance of a Platinum Elite member?**
No. Netting the points received applies to Titanium Elite and Ambassador Elite members only.
